name: partition_for_brick
note: brick number in; partition number out (0 if unassigned); reply result 0 and one integer

name: partition_environment
note: partition number in; integer and environment block out; sent by partmgr as the variables request

name: database_get
note: no argument; whole mode database out in one binary argument; builds the default first if none is loaded

name: database_time
note: no argument; the header timestamp out as one integer

name: database_set
note: complete database image in; header checks give results -1 to -6, older timestamp 7; installs, unpacks and writes flash; broadcasts the new image to task 5

name: mode_set
note: integer equal to the current timestamp plus a 24-byte header equal to the current one except the word at 0x10; installs that word; the meaning of the word is inferred as the current mode

name: park_request
note: slot 0 to 63 and the request itself kept in a table, no immediate reply; used for deferred replies

name: release_parked
note: slot and string; replies to the parked request in that slot with the string and clears the slot

name: chunk_first_flagged
note: first frame of a chunked message when bit 7 of packet byte 5 is set; header 9 bytes, payload up to 118

name: chunk_next
note: every later frame; length bytes zero
